rationale: The breakdown below $12.90 failed to generate follow-through over the last three 1-minute bars, finding support at $12.82–$12.83 before bouncing back to $12.90 (with the ask at $12.93). With only 3 minutes remaining before mandatory close liquidation and a widening 23.3 bps spread, the risk/reward of holding for a late breakdown is unfavorable against potential end-of-day short covering.
